CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.audit_business_connection_events()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare country text;
begin
  select country_code into country from public.businesses where id=new.requester_business_id;
  insert into public.access_audit(actor_id,action,resource,resource_id,country_code,metadata)
  values(auth.uid(),case when tg_op='INSERT' then 'connection_requested' else 'connection_request_'||new.status end,
    'connection_requests',new.id::text,country,
    jsonb_build_object('requester_business_id',new.requester_business_id,
      'target_business_id',new.target_business_id));
  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  insert into public.profiles (id, full_name, phone, country, role)
  values (
    new.id,
    coalesce(new.raw_user_meta_data->>'full_name', ''),
    nullif(new.raw_user_meta_data->>'phone', ''),
    coalesce(nullif(new.raw_user_meta_data->>'country', ''), 'Angola'),
    case
      when new.raw_user_meta_data->>'account_type' = 'customer' then 'customer'
      else 'business_owner'
    end
  );
  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_platform_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ select exists (select 1 from public.profiles where id = (select auth.uid()) and role in ('admin','moderator')); $function$

functions.name: is_platform_admin_only
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_platform_admin_only()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
    SELECT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.profiles AS p
        WHERE p.id = (SELECT auth.uid())
          AND p.role = 'admin'
    );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.log_business_lead_status_change()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if old.status is distinct from new.status then
    insert into public.business_lead_interactions
      (lead_id, business_id, interaction_type, summary, created_by)
    values
      (new.id, new.business_id, 'status_change',
       'Estado alterado de ' || old.status || ' para ' || new.status,
       auth.uid());
  end if;
  new.updated_at = now();
  return new;
end;
$function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.set_customer_service_request_updated_at()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
begin
  new.updated_at = now();
  if new.customer_id is distinct from old.customer_id
     or new.business_id is distinct from old.business_id
     or new.catalog_item_id is distinct from old.catalog_item_id
     or new.request_type is distinct from old.request_type
     or new.item_name_snapshot is distinct from old.item_name_snapshot
     or new.quantity is distinct from old.quantity
     or new.preferred_at is distinct from old.preferred_at
     or new.customer_message is distinct from old.customer_message
     or new.created_at is distinct from old.created_at then
    raise exception 'Os dados originais do pedido não podem ser alterados.';
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$function$
